# U08 — Detection validation results

**Not yet run.** This file is a placeholder generated by hand, not by
`scripts/metrics.py` — no attack traffic has been run against a real lab
from this environment (no isolated VirtualBox network, attacker VM, or
Metasploitable target is available here; see `updates/U08-validation-plan.md`
§3 for the required lab layout).

The tooling this deliverable depends on is built and unit-tested:

- `validation/criteria.md` — pass criteria, frozen verbatim from the U08 prompt.
- `validation/scripts/run_attacks.sh` — attack runner with the `LAB_CIDR`/
  gateway/platform-host scope guard (tested: refuses out-of-scope and
  gateway targets, dry-run verified against a real target/interface).
- `validation/scripts/collect.py` — collector against `/api/events`,
  `/api/incidents`, `/api/correlation/candidates` with keyset pagination
  (tested end-to-end against the running SentinelCore stack in this repo).
- `validation/scripts/metrics.py` — pass/fail grading, reduction ratio,
  latency percentiles, baseline FP rate (13 unit tests in
  `validation/tests/test_metrics.py`, including the zero-incidents /
  zero-division case, all passing).

To produce a real `RESULTS.md`: stand up the lab per `criteria.md` §3, run
`scripts/run_attacks.sh` for each attack class (A1–A8), run `scripts/collect.py`
against each `validation/runs/*.jsonl`, then run `scripts/metrics.py` — it
will overwrite this file with the real, computed report.

See also `docs/threat-model.md` — several controls there (T04 gateway/self
protection, T05 TTL enforcement) are exercised by this validation's
containment check.
